21STCENMGM.technical: Price cleared the 53.46 neckline on 2.42x volume, resting above the 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. However, base structure lacks smooth VCP contraction, and longer-term relative strength remains erratic.
21STCENMGM.fundamental: Deep net losses and negative operating revenue severely breach CANSLIM criteria. Return on equity stands at -21% for FY26 with unverified institutional sponsorship, making fundamental support nonexistent.
21STCENMGM.risk: A breakdown below the 47.58 stop negates the double bottom pattern; cut losses immediately to preserve capital.

63MOONS.technical: Constructive double bottom pullback to the rising 21-EMA near recent highs, printing a bullish reclaim candle toward 958.91 with positive MACD above signal and zero line.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite strong headline sales of Rs 137 Cr, bottom-line performance remains deep in the red with a Rs 47.6 Cr net loss. Subdued 3-year ROE fails O'Neil fundamental hurdles.
63MOONS.risk: Close below the 849.29 stop invalidates the pivot structure; apply strict Minervini stop-loss discipline.

AAATECH.technical: Price cleared a 20-day high at 121.82 on 1.85x volume, trading constructively above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 62 indicates sound momentum without overbought extension.
AAATECH.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction of -68% YoY coupled with a quarterly net loss of Rs 0.35 Cr violates CANSLIM parameters. Promoter holding remains low at 34.8% without institutional backing.
AAATECH.risk: Violation of the 102.52 stop aborts the breakout attempt; execute immediate loss-cutting rules.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: SEPA breakout displaying an extraordinary 67.7x 20-day volume expansion through the 454.10 pivot. Moving averages are aligned in Stage 2 sequence with RSI steady at 62.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: Sales grew +19.0% YoY to Rs 702.8 Cr, satisfying revenue thresholds, but net profit dipped 4.1% YoY to Rs 50.1 Cr. Moderate ROCE of 12% lacks dynamic institutional leadership characteristics.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: A drop below the 420.40 stop invalidates the heavy-volume breakout; exit swiftly to avoid prolonged drawdowns.

ABDL.technical: Constructive double bottom with neckline pressure at 767.67, supported by 1.46x volume and RSI 52. Moving average alignment (21-EMA > 50-SMA > 200-SMA) confirms early Stage 2 accumulation.
ABDL.fundamental: Q2 FY27 net profit rebounded +9.7% YoY to Rs 69 Cr alongside 6.8% revenue expansion. While margins improved to 12.4%, growth rates remain below CANSLIM's 25% EPS benchmark.
ABDL.risk: A close below the 705.04 stop breaks the swing-low support; exit unconditionally per disciplined risk limits.

ACUTAAS.technical: Classic CANSLIM/SEPA market leader breaking out of a double bottom base through 3903.90 on 3.67x volume. RSI at 69 and rising moving averages confirm superior institutional demand and relative strength.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Exemplary fundamentals with Q2 FY27 net profit surging +71.4% YoY and revenue rising +42.7%. EBITDA margins expanded to 40.3%, ROCE exceeds 31%, and debt is negligible with upward guidance revisions.
ACUTAAS.risk: Failure below 3555.57 pivot floor signals a shakeout; adhere strictly to stop discipline to preserve asymmetric reward.
